welcomeDesc: Hello, I'm Emirkan. I'm a Full-stack developer. If you're looking for someone to build robust and scalable frontend and backend products with great user experiences, let's achieve great things together!
javaScript: JavaScript is the most commonly used programming language for adding interactivity to websites. With this language, actions such as clicking buttons or filling out forms on web pages become dynamic. Today, it is used not only in browsers but also on servers thanks to Node.js technology. With this feature, JavaScript is a versatile language that can be used for both frontend and backend development. In short, JavaScript is one of the fundamental building blocks of the modern internet, and learning it is a major step forward in the world of software development.
reactJs: ReactJS is a JavaScript-based library used for building user interfaces. It was developed by Facebook and is one of the most popular frontend technologies today. Thanks to its component-based structure, React allows code to be more organized, reusable, and easy to manage. In addition to its Virtual DOM structure, it enables web pages to update quickly and improves performance. In short, ReactJS is an excellent tool for developing modern, fast, and scalable web applications.
Java: Java is a powerful, object-oriented programming language designed for building high-performance and platform-independent applications. Thanks to the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), Java applications can run on different operating systems without modification ('write once, run anywhere'). On the server side, Java is widely used for backend development, especially through frameworks such as Spring and Spring Boot. Its multi-threaded architecture, robust memory management (garbage collection), and rich standard libraries enable developers to build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems. Additionally, Java has a strong ecosystem supported by dependency management tools like Maven and Gradle. In short, Java is a reliable and efficient choice for modern software development, particularly for large-scale and long-lived backend solutions.
profileAboutMeAnsw: I graduated from Atatürk University with a degree in Computer Programming. I develop scalable, high-performance backend services with the Java ecosystem and Spring Boot, while designing user-centric, modern, and sustainable interfaces with React. I embrace object-oriented programming, clean code, and layered architecture principles, prioritizing code readability and testability. Key technical skills: Responsive interfaces with React, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 and CSS3; REST APIs and Spring Data JPA layers using Java and Spring Boot; SQL, Git/GitHub; data structures and algorithms, OOP and clean code principles. I am ready to contribute to professional projects on both the backend and frontend.
project_1: This project was developed entirely by me to showcase my CV on a web-based platform. It was implemented after completing the front-end development process, and all source code is publicly available on my GitHub account.
project_2: I present the text color guessing game I developed under the guidance and instructions of my instructor Alihan Güzel, whom I met while I was a part of Workintech. This project is one of the first front-end projects I developed, helping me improve my JavaScript logic and design skills. I have shared all the source code for this project openly on my GitHub account for everyone worldwide.
project_3: Web Pizza is another front-end project I developed while I was a part of Workintech. In this project, I focused heavily on the concepts of useState and Props, turning my knowledge of these topics into practical experience and creative problem-solving skills. I proudly present this project to your attention — all the source code is openly available on my GitHub account for everyone worldwide.
